info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Parking Reservations Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Status Retrieval API enables users to obtain the current status of their parking reservations. This endpoint provides a comprehensive view of reservation details, allowing users to efficiently manage and monitor their bookings. Common consumers of this API include parking management systems and applications that integrate parking functionalities. By leveraging this resource, users can ensure a seamless experience when tracking their parking reservations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of reservations in the system. It provides crucial information for users wanting to track the state of their reservations, ensuring transparency and improving user experience.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of reservations. Ensure to provide valid parameters for an accurate response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of the reservations.

ListParkingReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to the status of reservations. It is expected to be a string value.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.title: Reservation Status Response

status.description: Indicates whether the reservation status retrieval operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reservation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListParkingReservationsStatusResponse_20.description: A response object for the reservation status retrieval operation, containing the state of the reservation and associated metadata.
